record.question: The rights under Article 20 and Article 21 are unique because they cannot be suspended even during a:
record.explanation: Under Article 359 only Articles 14, 19 and 21 can be suspended during a National Emergency, and Article 20 and Article 21 are excluded from that suspension, so they cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency. Option (c) matches the printed Q42 on p.6.
